# kala_case (Data Source)

Looks up one case by case number, returning the full detail record.

The list endpoint returns roughly 25 fields; this one returns 64. Anything beyond identity and customer name must come from here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The case list returns roughly 25 fields; this endpoint returns 64. Anything
# past identity and customer name has to come from here.

data "kala_case" "one" {
  case_number = "KA-1" # the STRING number, not the integer id

  # Off by default. Financials are commercially sensitive AND transactional.
  # include_financials      = true
  # include_contact_details = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `case_number` (String) The case number to look up, e.g. `KA-1`. Note this is the **string** number, not the integer `id` that tasks reference.

### Optional

- `include_contact_details` (Boolean) Expose the customer email and phone. Off by default.
- `include_financials` (Boolean) Expose cost, sales, result, invoiced, uninvoiced, realised, and hour totals. **Off by default.** This is commercially sensitive and transactional data, and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Site address.
- `archived` (Boolean) Whether this case is archived. Derived from which set was requested, not from a response field: the list endpoint's own `isFinished` tracks archived-ness rather than completion and disagrees with the detail endpoint.
- `billed_hours` (Number) Hours billed. **Null unless `include_financials` is set.**
- `checklist_items_completed` (Number) How many of those are finished.
- `checklist_items_total` (Number) How many tasks (checklist items) the case holds.
- `cost` (Number) Recorded cost. **Null unless `include_financials` is set.**
- `customer_company` (String) Customer company name.
- `customer_email` (String) Customer email address. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- contact data is personal data and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.
- `customer_id` (Number) The customer this case belongs to. Null on internal projects. Join to `kala_customer.id`.
- `customer_name` (String) Customer contact name, denormalised onto the case.
- `customer_phone` (String) Customer phone number. **Null unless `include_contact_details` is set** -- contact data is personal data and everything exposed here is written to Terraform state.
- `deadline` (String) Case deadline, as RFC 3339. Null when unset upstream.
- `economy_case_number` (String) The e-conomic case number. In practice this **mirrors `number`**, including on Kala-native internal projects that have no e-conomic counterpart.
- `economy_sync_failed` (Boolean) Whether the last e-conomic sync failed. True on internal projects, which cannot sync.
- `end_date` (String) Case end date, as RFC 3339. Null when unset upstream.
- `favorite` (Boolean) Whether the case is flagged as a favourite.
- `id` (Number) Kala's internal case id. This is the value tasks reference via `case_id`.
- `internal_project` (Boolean) Whether this is an internal project rather than customer work. Internal projects have no customer.
- `invoiced` (Number) Amount invoiced. **Null unless `include_financials` is set.**
- `is_finished` (Boolean) Whether the case is finished. Sourced from the **detail** endpoint, where it means completion. The list endpoint has a field of the same name that tracks archived-ness instead; that one is not exposed.
- `name` (String) Case name.
- `number` (String) The case number, e.g. `KA-1`. This is how a case is addressed, and it is a **string** -- distinct from the integer `id`.
- `realised` (Number) Realised value. **Null unless `include_financials` is set.**
- `registered_hours_total` (Number) Hours registered on the case. **Null unless `include_financials` is set.**
- `restricted` (Boolean) Whether access to the case is restricted.
- `result` (Number) Sales minus cost. **Null unless `include_financials` is set.**
- `sales` (Number) Recorded sales. **Null unless `include_financials` is set.**
- `start_date` (String) Case start date, as RFC 3339. Null when unset upstream.
- `sub_text` (String) Secondary descriptive line.
- `uninvoiced` (Number) Amount not yet invoiced. **Null unless `include_financials` is set.**
- `zip` (String) Postal code.
